name: foker-monorepo
description: Foker: infraestructura determinista para agentes de IA que desarrollan monorepos TypeScript.

scripts.test: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:ts
scripts.coverage:rs: cargo llvm-cov -p foker-map --offline --summary-only --fail-under-lines 80 && cargo llvm-cov -p foker-context --offline --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex foker-map/ --fail-under-lines 80
scripts.verify: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -q -- -D warnings && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:deps && pnpm --filter @foker/schemas run generate:check && pnpm test
